content: Zeel yan guial sta rayaꞌp ree promejs ni been Dios guial yayaꞌp ree xguialraziiladxaman, rayal yayaꞌp ree cudad chitëë awa rayaꞌp ree promejs guin yayaꞌn tijb dunuj ree guial ad zayaꞌpt ree guialraziiladx guin.
Din dunuj ree ma bacaagdiajg ree xtiidxzaꞌc Jesucrist ziꞌcgajc laa reeman, per laa reeman achet sirv been guial bacaagdiajg reeman diidx guin ree, guial ad bililadxt reeman laan.
Per dunuj ree guial ma baliduladx ree xtiidx Dios, ma rayaꞌp ree guialraziiladx guin, saꞌn por ree bén ad bililadxt rëb Dios:

content.text: Guial bacheꞌch reeman naj zeel ma benan xgab
guial ad zajpt reeman da guialraziiladxan.

content: Diizd chi guleꞌcchaaw Dios guidxliuj baloox xchiinman,
ziꞌc rëb loj xtiidxaman por dxej ni raziiladx bejn:

content.text: Chi gulox been Dios gra xchiinman
dxel ni goc gajdx dxej baziiladxaman.

content: Per par ree bén ad bazoobt xtiidxaman rëbaman:

content.text: Ad yuꞌt dxej gap reeman da guialraziiladxan.

content: Bén biguiejn ree xtiidx Dios yaloj, ad gojpt reeman guialraziiladx guin guial ad bazoobt reeman xtiidxaman, per sta yuꞌ ree bén ryaadx gap guialraziiladx guin.
Zeel chi gudëd zien ijz, Dios gulëëca zatijb dxej ni na̱j yandxej. Abiꞌ ziꞌc ma rnin guial rëb rey Davi tib lajt loj xtiidx Dios:
Din bal por Josué niajp ree bén Israel guialraziiladx, ad nuzaꞌtt Dios zatijb dxej.
Zeel xt yandxej yuꞌ guialraziiladx guin par ree xbejn Dios.
Din bén rajp xguialraziiladx Dios, raziiladxaman xieen gra xchiinman ziꞌc baziiladx Dios chi gulox been xchiinman.
Zeel rayal yaguieen ree naguiejn yayaꞌp ree guialraziiladx guin, chitëë chu güün ziꞌc been ree bén ad bazoobt xtiidx Dios.

Din xtiidx Dios nabanan rajp tëën guialrniabee. Mazri rëëzan guial loj tijb espad ni nadoxh grop lad, rëëzan lën luxdoo bejn në lën xsprijtaman. Xt lën dxijt në lën yob rëëzan, abiꞌ por laan ragbee bejn bal ni mal o ni zagdxe na̱j ni rënman güünman.
Achetczi ni been Dios zajc guiguieꞌch lojman, din gradooczan ruguiaaman, abiꞌ lojman na̱j yadëëd ree cwent.
Zeel guial ma rayaꞌp ree bixhioz ni mazri zojbloj, abiꞌ laaman na̱j Jesucrist Xiꞌn Dios, bén ma zojb xanyabaa, rayal yasnuu yadxuꞌdxiꞌch ree loj ni raliladx ree laaman.
Din Jesucrist bén na̱j dux bixhioz zojbloj ree laaman zajc gagnë dunuj ree chitëë güün dol dunuj ree gan. Din në laaman guzajc graloj ziꞌcgajc cayzaꞌc ree, per laaman ad yuꞌt dxej beenman dol.

Zeel con confianz ma zajc yabiig ree loj Dios yarejdx yanaab reeman, bén rën dunuj ree par yayaman dunuj ree. Abiꞌ guial rënman dunuj ree, laaman gagnë dunuj ree loj hor ni yayën ree chu güün dunuj ree yudar.
